models.observations: The raised bell chamber cuts through the low clay wings. Its posts, thick lintel and central approach read from above. Glazed pots flank the stair and blue shutters punctuate the ochre frontage. The reopened GLB passed the serialized validator at 839, 409, 155 triangles across its three LODs.

The projecting timber gable and shake-roofed stone hall read as two masses. Exposed jambs anchor the porch and its banner. The side bench and flower box break up the stone plinth. The reopened GLB passed the serialized validator at 913, 567, 101 triangles across its three LODs.

The reed laps and lower speaker’s porch remain separate at 64 px. The calling drum, ridge lashings and blue gable shield make the gathering hall feel inhabited. Steps meet the porch under a timber frame. The reopened GLB passed the serialized validator at 905, 419, 109 triangles across its three LODs.

The open bell tower and slate ridge give this hall a tall public face. The projecting framed upper chamber sits over a stone lower storey. The porch shield, garden and smoking-range flue reinforce the council-hall family. The reopened GLB passed the serialized validator at 1192, 757, 165 triangles across its three LODs.

The drum separates the terracotta dome from the lower tiled roof at phone size. The central door and two flanking arched windows establish a measured facade. Flowers, flag and finial give the entrance scale. The reopened GLB passed the serialized validator at 948, 481, 171 triangles across its three LODs.

Four pale columns land below the porch entablature. The broad steps and terracotta pediment stay legible at 64 px. Blue heraldry and a small planter humanize the otherwise formal order. The reopened GLB passed the serialized validator at 877, 549, 163 triangles across its three LODs.

The continuous gold ring and three articulated piers read in silhouette around the pearl dome. The contrasting glazing band separates the drum from the roof. Planted beds, shield and roof beacon locate the civic entrance. The reopened GLB passed the serialized validator at 1036, 669, 321 triangles across its three LODs.

The stepped pair of glass towers and low public canopy remain clear at 64 px. Blue glazing, white floor bands and the small entrance shield are well balanced. A vertical intersection check at the secondary rooftop aerial confirms a gap of 0.020645 tile. The reopened GLB passed the serialized validator at 638, 327, 187 triangles across its three LODs.
